origin: Prepared by implementer; independent reviewer must invent at least one new counterexample.
question: Is the P1 proposed test package sufficient to expose real limitations of the current E1 chain composer before implementing a network linter? Challenge construct validity, false positives and false negatives.

current_implementation.material_topology: E1 composer.py uses source-to-receipt material chain, one material successor per source and one incoming per receiver; no native split/merge in registered base.
current_implementation.information_topology: Information path from receipt tap is a linear SIGNAL path; dynamic CONTROL mechanism is not implemented.
current_implementation.catalog: AcceptedSource, BoundedQueue, DeliveryCounter, FirstOrderReportFilter; same registered molecular class for preparation/dispatch/transit with roles; declarative type and parameter bounds.
current_implementation.execution: E1 backend generates Modelica for candidate chains and fixed pulse/step/ramp/high-pulse stimuli, no general network policies.
current_implementation.semantic_evidence: No machine-checked support/hypothesis bindings per instance or link.

sketches.description: Customers arrive to a single waiting stock; service and walk-away are distinct possible outputs. A recorded departure count exists, but the actual abandonment policy/rate law is unspecified.
One measured incoming customer flow is sent unchanged to both a service output and a walk-away output; no split policy or other source is declared.
A disease-spread/adoption module with interface dimensions customers/hour is proposed as explanation for walk-away, without any interaction evidence.
Waiting is said to decrease service or increase walk-away, with no registered policy, parameters or proven control input.

A domain-generic reservoir/output-limit module originally used for orders is proposed for customer count when its semantic contract can conserve individual customers; a physical adapter has not been verified.

constraints: No author/model assigned as executable graph constructor.
Distinguish preserving ability to express a hypothesis vs actual numerical execution.
No candidate's true world or numerical answer exists or is provided.
Do not invent a positive implementation capability merely because paper grammar names it.
No changes to roadmap or catalog in this review.
requested_output: Return Spanish detailed JSON with findings array fields id,severity BLOCKS_P1|BLOCKS_P2|NON_BLOCKING,source,problem,falsifying_case,requested_fix; also at least one independent NEW counterexample outside Q1-Q5, and overall CONTINUE_P1|REPAIR_BRIEF|STOP.
